notes: CERT DISCIPLINE — statewide credit comes ONLY from OSDS 2009473. San Diego SLBE 17BB1659 and LA County DVBE 10086 are LOCAL certifications and earn no state credit; never cite them for a statewide bid.

SB PREFERENCE APPLIES — claim it. The OSDS certification 2009473 carries BOTH SB and DVBE, so on California competitive solicitations, informal included, BBS is entitled to the 5% Small Business preference (SCM §1204) AND the DVBE incentive (SCM §1202). Neither applies to an LPA/NASPO order, a federal bid (SDVOSB only), or storefront copy. The storefront doctrine's 'never claim SB credit' is about storefront copy alone — it is not a statement that BBS lacks SB certification. Ruling reversed by Parker 2026-09-02; bbs-foundations canonical-facts is the source.
In FEDERAL context BBS is SDVOSB, not DVBE. DVBE is the California term. Do not mix them on one form.
A manufacturer's own GSA or contract vehicle does not authorize BBS to fulfill unless BBS is a named reseller.
